  "When adding new parameters to decorators like `click.option`, ensure the underlying `Param` class (or its relevant subclass) also accepts the new parameter in its `__init__` method.",
  "New features or parameters should be added to the lowest-level class that represents them (e.g., `Param` for parameters, `Command` for commands) before being exposed through decorators or higher-level APIs."
]
